newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra sees 127,000 house starts in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra sees 127,000 house starts in 1996/97.

text.p: The Australian government's housing forecaster, the Indicative Planning Council for the Housing Industry, on Tuesday confirmed its October forecast of 127,000 housing starts in the fiscal year to June.
The industry commenced building 124,550 homes in 1995/96.
"The (council) still estimates an excess stock of 26,000 dwellings at June 1996, down from 49,000 at June 1995," the council said in a statement.
It would meet again in April to again review its forecasts.
The Industry Department said housing starts seemed to have reached a minimum.
"Dwelling commencements appear to have troughed in the September quarter 1996, in line with the (council's) most recent forecast," the department said in a separate statement.
